items.title: Controlling Reasoning Effort in LLMs

items.contentSnippet: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes

summaries.zh: 文章标题为《控制大型语言模型的推理努力》。内容主要探讨了大型语言模型如何学习低、中、高三种推理努力模式。通过分析不同推理模式的机制和特点，揭示了模型在不同任务中调整推理深度的方法。总结来说，文章重点介绍了LLM如何根据任务需求灵活切换推理努力水平，以优化性能和效率。
summaries.en: The article explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) develop low-, medium-, and high-effort reasoning modes. It examines the mechanisms enabling these models to adjust their reasoning complexity based on task requirements, input prompts, and computational constraints. The content likely discusses the factors influencing effort levels, such as prompt structure and model architecture, and how LLMs optimize performance by selecting appropriate reasoning modes. The focus is on understanding the learning processes behind adaptive reasoning in LLMs.

items.title: Recent Developments in LLM Architectures: KV Sharing, mHC, and Compressed Attention
items.content: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs
items.contentSnippet: From Gemma 4 to DeepSeek V4, How New Open-Weight LLMs Are Reducing Long-Context Costs

summaries.zh: 近期，新型开源大语言模型（如Gemma 4和DeepSeek V4）通过引入KV共享、mHC（多头注意力优化）和压缩注意力等技术，显著降低了长文本处理的成本。这些架构改进提升了模型在长上下文任务中的效率，同时保持性能。通过优化内存和计算资源的使用，新模型在保持高质量输出的同时，有效解决了长文本处理中的资源瓶颈问题。
summaries.en: Recent open-weight LLMs like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 are reducing long-context costs through innovations such as KV sharing, mHC (multi-head cross-attention), and compressed attention. These advancements aim to optimize memory and computational efficiency while maintaining performance. KV sharing minimizes redundant key-value storage, mHC enhances attention mechanisms, and compressed attention reduces memory usage. These techniques collectively address the challenges of handling extended contexts in large language models. The developments highlight progress in optimizing LLM architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness.

items.summary: 近期，新型开源大语言模型（如Gemma 4和DeepSeek V4）通过引入KV共享、mHC（多头注意力优化）和压缩注意力等技术，显著降低了长文本处理的成本。这些架构改进提升了模型在长上下文任务中的效率，同时保持性能。通过优化内存和计算资源的使用，新模型在保持高质量输出的同时，有效解决了长文本处理中的资源瓶颈问题。

summaries.en: The article outlines a learning-oriented workflow for understanding new open-weight model releases, particularly large language models (LLMs). It emphasizes a structured approach to grasp LLM architectures effectively. The workflow likely involves systematic analysis, experimentation, and documentation to decode the complexities of these models. By following this method, learners can gain insights into how LLMs operate and evolve. The focus is on practical engagement with open-weight models to enhance comprehension. This approach aims to demystify LLM architectures for both beginners and experienced practitioners.

summaries.zh:
标题：编码代理的组成部分  

内容摘要：编码代理通过工具、记忆和仓库上下文来提升大型语言模型（LLMs）的实践效果。这些组件协同工作，使LLMs在编程任务中表现更佳。
summaries.en: A coding agent leverages tools, memory, and repository context to enhance the practical performance of large language models (LLMs). By integrating these components, the agent improves efficiency and accuracy in coding tasks. Tools provide specific functionalities, memory retains past interactions, and repo context offers relevant codebase information. This combination allows LLMs to execute tasks more effectively, addressing real-world coding challenges. The approach optimizes LLM capabilities for practical applications.

items.title: A Visual Guide to Attention Variants in Modern LLMs
items.content: From MHA and GQA to MLA, sparse attention, and hybrid architectures
items.contentSnippet: From MHA and GQA to MLA, sparse attention, and hybrid architectures

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了现代大型语言模型（LLMs）中的注意力机制变体。主要涵盖MHA（多头注意力）、GQA（稀疏注意力）和MLA（混合架构）等关键技术。文章通过视觉指南形式，展示了不同注意力机制的结构和特点，有助于理解其在模型中的应用。
summaries.en: This article provides a visual guide to attention variants in modern large language models (LLMs). It covers key architectures including MHA (Multi-Head Attention), GQA (Generalized Query Attention), MLA (Multi-Query Attention), sparse attention, and hybrid models. The content focuses on explaining these different attention mechanisms and their applications in enhancing model performance and efficiency.

items.title: Nemotron 3 Super Throughput Notes
items.content: Nemotron 3 Super combines Mamba-2, Latent MoE, sparse GQA, and shared-weight MTP in a throughput-oriented 120B-A12B model.
items.contentSnippet: Nemotron 3 Super combines Mamba-2, Latent MoE, sparse GQA, and shared-weight MTP in a throughput-oriented 120B-A12B model.

summaries.zh: Nemotron 3 Super是一款混合Mamba-Transformer的MoE模型，采用120B参数和12B专家的混合架构，结合了潜在专家和共享权重MTP技术。该模型旨在提升处理能力，适用于高性能计算任务。
summaries.en: Nemotron 3 Super is a 120B-A12B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE model featuring latent experts and shared-weight MTP. It combines Mamba and Transformer architectures with a mixed expertise approach. The model leverages latent expert activation and shared weights for efficiency. Its design aims to enhance performance and scalability in large-scale applications.
